title: Clustered Randomized Smoothing for Stochastic Prediction Functions
abstract: arXiv:2608.12037v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern stochastic predictors can model rich, multi-modal outcome distributions. However, this expressive power comes with challenges in ensuring robust predictions $-$ a critical requirement in safety-critical domains. Randomized smoothing is a leading technique for improving robustness, particularly against adversarial perturbations. Yet, in stochastic multi-modal regression settings, randomized smoothing often fails due to mode collapse, yielding averaged predictions that do not reflect the underlying distribution. To address this limitation, we propose clustered $\alpha$-smoothing, a framework that (1) partitions noisy samples using an arbitrary clustering algorithm, (2) applies $\alpha$-smoothing locally within each cluster, and (3) combines the resulting predictions into a mixture distribution. translated_title: 聚类随机平滑用于随机预测函数
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12037v1 公告类型：新 摘要：现代随机预测器能够建模丰富、多模态的结果分布。然而，这种表达能力在确保鲁棒预测方面带来了挑战——这是安全关键领域中的关键要求。随机平滑是提高鲁棒性的领先技术，特别是针对对抗性扰动。然而，在随机多模态回归设置中，随机平滑常常因模式崩溃而失败，导致平均值预测无法反映潜在分布。为解决这一限制，我们提出了聚类α-平滑框架，该框架（1）使用任意聚类算法对噪声样本进行分区，（2）在每个聚类内局部应用α-平滑，以及（3）将所得预测组合成混合分布。通过将平滑分布解释为α-平滑器的混合，我们推导出平滑预测满足鲁棒性保证的概率下界。
tldr: 提出了聚类α-平滑框架，通过聚类分区和局部平滑来克服随机多模态回归中随机平滑的模式崩溃问题，并提供了鲁棒性概率下界。
en_tdlr: Proposes a clustered α-smoothing framework that partitions noisy samples via clustering and applies local smoothing to overcome mode collapse in stochastic multi-modal regression, with a derived robustness probability lower bound.
